task.title: Command primitive perf polish: mount-time O(N^2) residue, CommandEmpty scan, mousemove highlight churn, visible_ids clones
task.description:
From the P6-137 review (2026-08-12) of the vendored Command primitive (app/src/components/ui/command.rs) after its keystroke O(N^2) fix — all remaining polish, none user-visible at current sizes:

1. Mount is still O(N^2): each item's aria-selected render effect reads ctx.visible right after its own items.push invalidated it, forcing a recompute over the partial registry once per item (~:87 comment overstates the fix as 'O(N) total').
2. CommandEmpty::any_visible (~:354) still scans items directly — a future consumer pairing CommandEmpty with a large list recreates the O(N^2) the module doc says is closed (not hit today; SetPicker has its own empty state).
3. on:mousemove (~:445-451) calls visible_ids() (full clone) and unconditionally highlight.set(pos) per event, re-running N highlighted memos even when the hovered row is unchanged — gate on pos change.
4. visible_ids() clones the whole Vec per call; on_keydown does it twice per arrow key (~:128-147,228,301) — switch to with()-style reads.

Also from the same review, separate concern: SheetContent (app/src/components/ui/sheet.rs:153-180) renders children unconditionally — the closed mobile sheet keeps its whole subtree mounted CSS-off-screen (doubles the cost of anything heavy in the rail, and is the clickable-targets-behind-scrim trap class the e2e notes describe). Consider conditional mounting with the dialog/overlay conventions, carefully (animations, focus).
